en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīya (2), Dukadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (6) 12.20.
Saraṇaduka, Dassanenapahātabbadukādi (The Pair on Having an Object of Refuge, etc.)

Dependent on a state that is not a refuge and is to be abandoned by vision … dependent on a state that is not a refuge and is to be abandoned by non-vision … dependent on a state that is not a refuge and is to be abandoned by cultivation … dependent on a state that is not a refuge and is to be abandoned by non-cultivation … dependent on a state that is not a refuge and has a root to be abandoned by vision … [and so forth].

Dependent on a state whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing and non-knowledge … dependent on a state whose root is to be abandoned by non-seeing and non-knowledge … dependent on a state whose root is to be abandoned by non-cultivation … (Abbreviated. With respect to root: five;
with respect to object: two … with respect to result: one … with respect to non-disappearance: five.

Dependent on a state that is non-dispersing and has a cause to be abandoned by development … dependent on a state that is non-dispersing and without initial application … [and so on] … dependent on a state that is non-dispersing and without sustained application … [abbreviated].
Under root condition there are three; under object condition … [and so on].
One [condition] ... [and so on] ... three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither-included-in-the-round-of-rebirths nor without-sustained-thinking ... (Abbreviated. Two for root-cause ... [and so on] ... one for fruition ... [and so on] ... two for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither-included-in-the-round-of-rebirths nor accompanied by zest ... dependent on a state that is neither-included-in-the-round-of-rebirths nor accompanied by rapture ... [and so on].

… pe … dependent on a state that is not a refuge and not accompanied by rapture … pe … dependent on a state that is not a refuge and not accompanied by non-rapture … pe … dependent on a state that is not a refuge and not accompanied by pleasure … pe … dependent on a state that is not a refuge and not accompanied by non-pleasure … pe … dependent on a state that is not a refuge and not accompanied by equanimity … (Abbreviated.)
In the case of root condition, five; in the case of object condition, two ... pe ... in the case of resultant condition, one ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance condition, five.

Dependent on a state that is not associated with clinging and not accompanied by equanimity ... (Abbreviated. In the case of root condition, two ... pe ... in the case of resultant condition, one ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance condition, two.
Dependent on a state that is not associated with clinging and not belonging to the sense sphere ... [End of section].

Dependent on a non-outflowing (*anāsava*) state that is neither of the sense-sphere (*na-kāmāvacara*), [dependent on] a non-outflowing state that is neither of the fine-material sphere (*na-rūpāvacara*) ... [dependent on] a non-outflowing state that is neither of the immaterial sphere (*na-arūpāvacara*) ... (Abbreviated. Under root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*), five; under object-condition (*ārammaṇa-paccaya*), two ... [and so on] ... under result-condition (*vipāka-paccaya*), one ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance-condition (*avigata-paccaya*), five. Dependent on a non-outflowing state that is neither of the fine-material sphere ... dependent on a non-outflowing state that is neither of the sense-sphere nor of the fine-material sphere ...
dependent on a non-outflowing state that is neither of the immaterial sphere ... (Abbreviated. Under root-condition, five; under object-condition, [two].
Two ... [and so on] ... two results, one ... [and so on] ... five non-disappearance conditions.
Dependent on a state that is neither clinging nor fine-material-sphere ...
dependent on a state that is neither clinging nor included [in the mundane] ...

Dependent on a state that is not a canker (*āsava*) and not included within the mundane (*apariyāpanna*) … (Abbreviated. Five by way of root-cause (*hetu*), two by way of object (*ārammaṇa*) … pe … one by way of result (*vipāka*) … pe … five by way of non-disappearance (*avigata*).

Dependent on a state that is not a canker and not leading out [from suffering] (*aniyyānika*) … (Abbreviated. Five by way of root-cause, two by way of object … pe … one by way of result … pe … five by way of non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is not a canker and not leading out [from suffering] … [End of section].

Dependent on a state that is neither subject to cankers (*asava*) nor indeterminate (*aniyata*)... (Abbreviated. Five [conditions] in the case of root-cause (*hetu*); two in the case of object (*ārammaṇa*) ... pe ... one in the case of result (*vipāka*) ... pe ... five in the case of non-disappearance (*avigata*).
Dependent on a state that is neither subject to cankers nor indeterminate...

Dependent on a state that is neither subject to cankers nor unsurpassed (*anuttara*), a state that is neither subject to cankers nor unsurpassed arises by way of the root-cause condition (*hetupaccaya*).
Dependent on a state that is neither a refuge nor supreme, a state that is neither a refuge nor supreme arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither a thicket nor supreme, a state that is neither a thicket nor supreme arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither a thicket nor supreme, a state that is neither a refuge nor supreme arises by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither a refuge nor supreme, which is neither free from affliction nor supreme, there arise states that are neither a refuge nor supreme, which are neither free from affliction nor supreme, by way of the root condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither a refuge nor supreme, and which is neither free from affliction nor supreme, there arises a state that is neither a refuge nor supreme, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of root-cause condition, five; in the case of object condition, two ... pe ... in the case of resultant condition, one ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance condition, five.

(The full detail applies everywhere. The co-nascent section, the conditionality section, the dependence section, the conjoined section, the associated section, and the inquiry section should all be expanded in detail.)
The presentation of the pairs and dyads in the negative order regarding phenomena is finished.
The Negative Presentation (Paccanīya Paṭṭhāna) is finished.
